messages:
Ravi P.: Opened a small docs PR to add an alternate NAT egress pattern for Private installs and an SNI note for KMS TLS checks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2107

Hannah (docs): Can you include both nftables and iptables examples and a short "how to validate" section for Support?

Ravi P.: Added both snippets. Kept examples minimal. Also called out that Envoy should set `sni` in the upstream cluster to match the KMS TLS name. Example entry in the PR:

```
clusters:
  - name: kms-upstream
    tls_context:
      common_tls_context:
        tls_certificates:
          - certificate_chain: { filename: "/etc/redwood/certs/client.crt" }
            private_key: { filename: "/etc/redwood/certs/client.key" }
    sni: "kms.internal.redwood"
```

Marco: Added nftables DNAT I tested in the sealed-site lab:

```
nft add table ip redwood_nat
nft add chain ip redwood_nat prerouting { type nat hook prerouting priority 0 ; }
nft add rule ip redwood_nat prerouting tcp dport 443 dnat to 10.0.0.1:443
```

Ravi P.: Also included iptables equivalent and a conntrack note for long-lived gRPC streams. Air-gapped note: bundle `ca_bundle.pem` in installer and set REDWOOD_KMS_CA=/etc/redwood/certs/ca_bundle.pem in systemd env. File perms: `chown root:root && chmod 600 client.key`.

Hannah (docs): Please add quick validation commands for Support: curl with `--cacert` and `openssl s_client -servername`.

Ravi P.: Added these two lines to troubleshooting:

```
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca_bundle.pem https://kms.internal.redwood/health
openssl s_client -connect kms.internal.redwood:443 -servername kms.internal.redwood -showcerts -CAfile ca_bundle.pem
```

Marco: Preflight test on sealed-site passed for the nftables flow. Noted a small doc wording fix for CA order (root last vs first).

Hannah (docs): Made the wording tweak about CA order and merged after CI passed. I'll create the Support KB stub linking these checks."
